name: Fray
description: A frayed strip: the weave letting go along both selvedges.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 16%; top: 0; width: 68%; height: 100%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3), var(--color4), var(--color5)); filter: @svg-filter(feTurbulence { type: fractalNoise; baseFrequency: 0.02 0.3; numOctaves: 2; seed: 5 } feDisplacementMap { in: SourceGraphic; scale: 10 }); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } -webkit-transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); transform: rotate(@pick(0deg, 90deg)); } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
